name: Lucid Descent
summary:
Step into your nightmares  and never wake up.
Lucid Descent is a VR horror fan game inspired by Gorilla Tag, where reality fractures and primal fear takes over. You aren’t just running for fun anymore you’re running to survive.

In this twisted, dreamlike descent, the familiar mechanics of Gorilla Tag are reborn in a surreal, haunting world that shifts with every heartbeat. The walls whisper. The floors breathe. And somewhere in the darkness, something hunts you.
